name: sensibleBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Trigger boxes resolved from the SENSIBLEBOXES property (designer property 0) via Scn_FindIdList; the door opens while the Wolf or the module-static Sam stands inside any of them. | count (+4): Element count returned through Scn_FindIdList's u16 out-parameter (this+0x64+4) and passed to BoxList_FindContainingPoint. 0x6a/0x6b are the natural alignment of the {Box **; u16} pair — nothing references them, so no field belongs there.

name: state
meaning: 0 closed (anim 2, boxes solid), 1 open (anim 4), 2 opening (anim 3, collision switched OFF at the first frame of the move), 3 closing (anim 1, collision switched ON at the first frame) — so the doorway is passable the instant it starts to open but blocks the instant it starts to close. Read with mov
